Date April 5, 1937.

Subject Celebration of the Flower Festival by the Japanese Buddhist
Sunday School Federation on April 4, 1937.
Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by Iboyu OSI

With reference to the attached, I have to state that
the flower festival was celebrated by the local Japanese
Buddhist Sunday School Federation as scheduled. Children
attending Sunday Schools left Quinsan Garden at 10 a.m. April
4 and proceeded to the Kokusan Garden(Chapei) via Quinsan,
Woosung, Kashing, Dixwell and North Szchuen Roads. Police
from Hongkew Police Station escorted them to the Tien Tung An
railway crossing. No untoward incident occurred.

D. Kamashita

日期：1937年4月5日。

事由：日本佛教主日学联合会于1937年4月4日庆祝花节。
撰写人：D. S. Kamashita 转呈人：Iboyu OSI

关于附件内容，兹陈述如下：
当地日本佛教主日学联合会按计划庆祝了花节。参加主日学的儿童于4月4日上午10时离开昆山路花园（Quinsan Garden），经昆山路、吴淞路、嘉善路、狄思威路及北四川路，前往国三花园（Kokusan Garden，位于闸北）。虹口捕房的警员护送他们至天通庵铁路道口。未发生任何意外事件。

Date March 30, 1937.
Subject Celebration of the Flower Festival by Japanese Buddhist Sunday
School Federation on April 4, 1937.
Made by D.S. Kamashita Forwarded by Iboyn D.S.I

The flower festival, which is celebrated annually by
the Japanese Buddhist Sunday School Federation in commemoration
of the anniversary of the birth of Buddha, will be observed
at the Rokuson Garden, Kiangwan Road (Chapei), on April 4,
1937.

Some 300 children of various Buddhist Sunday schools
are expected to participate in the festivities. They will
meet in Quinsan Garden at 9.30 a.m. on April 4. Thence,
headed by a band, they will proceed on foot to the Rokuson
Garden, Kiangwan Road (Chapei), taking the following route:-
Quinsan, Woosung, Kashing, Dixwell and North Szechuen
Roads, and over the Tien Tung An Railway crossing to the
Rokuson Garden.

The function will terminate at about 4 p.m., when the
participants will disperse at the Garden.

D. Kamashita
D. S.

日本佛教主日学联合会每年为纪念佛陀诞辰周年而庆祝的花节，将于1937年4月4日在江湾路（闸北）的六三花园（Rokuson Garden）举行。

预计约有300名来自各佛教主日学的儿童将参加庆祝活动。他们将于4月4日上午9时30分在昆山路花园集合。随后，在乐队的带领下，他们将步行前往江湾路（闸北）的六三花园，路线如下：
昆山路、吴淞路、嘉善路、狄思威路和北四川路，并经天通庵铁路道口到达六三花园。

活动将于下午4时左右结束，届时参与者将在花园解散。

The Hana-Matsuri (Flower Festival), which is observed
annually by the Japanese Buddhist Sunday School Federation
to commemorate the anniversary of the birth of Buddha, will
be held at the Rokusan Garden in Chinese territory, off North

In celebration of this festival some 400 children of

Garden to the Rokusan Garden taking the following route:-

roads, and over the Tien Tung An Railway Crossing

participants will disperse at the garden.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D 5786 Date. April 7. 1934）

Subject (in full) Celebration of the annual flower festival by Japanese Buddhist Sunday Schools.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by Em Golan D.S.I.

In celebration of the 2,500 anniversary of the birth of Buddha, members of the various Japanese Buddhist Sunday Schools will observe the "Hana Matsuri" (Flower Festival) at the Rokusan Garden in Chinese territory off Hongkew Park on April 8.

In this connection some 300 children under the care of teachers and guardians will participate in a procession which will proceed at 10 a.m. from the Quinsan Square to the ceremonial ground taking the following route:- Quinsan, Woosung, Thorne or Kashing, Dixwell, North Szechuen, Kiangwan Roads, thence into Chinese territory.

The celebration will terminate late in the afternoon and the party will be dispersed at the Rokusan Garden.

D. S. Umemoto.
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C & S. B. 登记处。档案号 D 5786 日期 1934年4月7日）

事由（全文）：日本佛教主日学庆祝年度花节。

撰写人：D. S. Umemoto。转呈人：Em Golan D.S.I.

为庆祝佛陀诞辰2500周年，各日本佛教主日学的成员将于4月8日在虹口公园以外、位于中国地界内的六三花园（Rokusan Garden）举行“花祭”（Hana Matsuri，花节）。

为此，约有300名儿童在教师和监护人的照料下，将参加游行队伍。队伍将于上午10时从昆山路广场出发前往仪式场地，路线如下：昆山路、吴淞路、汤姆路（Thorne）或嘉善路、狄思威路、北四川路、江湾路，随后进入中国地界。

庆祝活动将于下午晚些时候结束，队伍将在六三花园解散。

D. S. Umemoto。
D. S.

副总监，
特别股。
